ActiveSupport::JSON.encode calls value.as_json. In actionpack-6.1.7.7/lib/action_controller/metal/strong_parameters.rb line 246-247 `as_json` is DELEGATED `to: :@parameters` (an ActiveSupport::HashWithIndifferentAccess) — so ActionController::Parameters#as_json returns the underlying nested hash (recursing through nested Parameters via Hash#as_json), NOT a {"parameters":...,"permitted":...} wrapper and NOT a stringified Parameters. Therefore every Parameters/Hash value serializes to a real JSON object; nil serializes to nil (NULL).
